## Assignment 3: Consensus Phylogenetic Tree

```{r}
library(phangorn)

trees <- read.nexus("/Users/haillebright/Downloads/tree-pruner-d3e061e9-25c5-45cd-952b-b1f175bd99c0/output.nex")

consensus_tree <- ape::consensus(trees, p = 0.5)

plot(consensus_tree, cex = 0.4, no.margin = TRUE)
```
